regions.name: Irrawaddy
regions.quote: Although this species is known to be common for part of its range (Irrawaddy River drainage), uncertainties regarding the taxonomic status of the Ganges-Brahmaputra and Irrawaddy populations and the lack of population information in the Ganges-Brahmaputra system make it impossible to accurately assess this species.
